text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month treasury bills rose from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Three-month bills edged up to 24.24 percent from from 20.22 percent, six-month bills rose to 30.34 percent from 30.23 percent, nine-month bills rose to 32.93 percent from 32.78 percent and 12-month bills edged up to 37.54 percent from 35.99 percent.
The results of Thursday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.22 million UAH 42.43 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.15 million UAH 40.39 million UAH
The central bank sold 12,230 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 28.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 6.00 million UAH
Amount sold 2.59 million UAH 5.99 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.25 million UAH 5.20 million UAH
The central bank sold 25,862 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 28.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 12.00 million UAH
Amount sold 2.91 million UAH 11.73 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.34 million UAH 9.42 million UAH
The central bank sold 29,124 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 28.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 17.67 million UAH 8.69 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.85 million UAH 6.40 million UAH
The central bank sold 176,663 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 28.
